signature.name: VTask.sumCompl
signature.type: {α : Type u_9} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> { a // p a } ⊕ { a // ¬p a } ≃ α

conventions.statement: The forward map of the equivalence sends both Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩ and Sum.inr ⟨a, h⟩ to the underlying element a, discarding the proof witness.
conventions.note: This is the canonical copairing of the two subtype inclusion maps.

conventions.statement: The inverse map sends a : α to Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩ if p a holds (h : p a) and to Sum.inr ⟨a, h⟩ if ¬ p a holds (h : ¬ p a), using the DecidablePred instance to branch.
conventions.note: Decidability is required to make the inverse computable.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x : { a // p a }), (VTask.sumCompl p) (Sum.inl x) = x.val
